g.text: Check boolean VelimirEclipse

g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j1138299529->Chat ends.
g.text: false

g.title: j4173473723->Chat ends.
g.text: false

g.title: j1957781517
g.text: Hey... guys?

g.title: j4173473723->j1957781517
g.text: true

g.title: j4204399939
g.text: MomToxicated: Yes?

g.title: j3682974464
g.text: PapaPolar: what's up lil buddy?

g.title: j3804243851
g.text: I have good news and I have bad news. About Neci.

g.title: j2364347197
g.text: I need you both not to get your hopes up. I have news about Neci, but it's... mixed. And inconclusive.

g.title: j1523382966
g.text: Fff... Actually, never mind. [End.]

g.title: j339206209
g.text: PapaPolar: do it the adult way. bad news first.

g.title: j87471203
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3422489228
g.text: MomToxicated: I agree. Bad news always comes first.

g.title: j3344408859
g.text: MomToxicated: All things in life generally are. But thank you for the warning.

g.title: j2369784922
g.text: So. The Indifference went to Duviri. and it... took Neci there with it.

g.title: j4116743482
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1642358943
g.text: PapaPolar: wait. wait wait. that storybook dimension thing?

g.title: j1266889416
g.text: PapaPolar: bracing for the news, but it sounds like she's... not dead, at least?

g.title: j3894005793
g.text: MomToxicated: The one with the child dictator that kept killing you repeatedly?

g.title: j3191483663
g.text: I don't... know. I don't think so. But let me just tell you what I do know, and I'll let you two be the judges.

g.title: j4270279999
g.text: Turns out this was kind of a growth moment for him? Not the point. Anyway-

g.title: j2682093934
g.text: That's the one.

g.title: j1052418591
g.text: Neci... took the throne. The Murmur - The Indifference's "army" for lack of a better word, invaded, and she took over.

g.title: j574965604
g.text: MomToxicated: Heh. That's my little girl.

g.title: j2736723701
g.text: PapaPolar: but was it really *her* though? or just that thing wearing her face?

g.title: j1779485264
g.text: I don't know.

g.title: j924820805
g.text: That's what I wanted to talk to you about.

g.title: j1631034715
g.text: I found these records. They were disjointed at first. But when I put them all together, I... got this message.

g.title: j3398355259
g.text: I was curious if it made any sense to you.

g.title: j3412958188
g.text: MomToxicated: Riddles and strange messages? You're speaking our language.

g.title: j2711678559
g.text: PapaPolar: 1-800-spy-shit, you've come to the right place

g.title: j2981190172
g.text: "For when Sol and Lua align, the lost shall find their way home."

g.title: j3199371614
g.text: PapaPolar: ....shit. M. SHIT.

g.title: j1075534443
g.text: MomToxicated: Don't fall for it. If that thing's inside her head, it knows what she knows.

g.title: j1500002417
g.text: What? What does it mean?

g.title: j3190246910
g.text: It's the other half, isn't it?

g.title: j2624068937
g.text: PapaPolar: "On empty crossroads, seek the eclipse."

g.title: j2794452938
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1421952144
g.text: PapaPolar: what i told you to tell our lil girl if you saw her again.

g.title: j2303711172
g.text: PapaPolar: you got it...

g.title: j1780081437
g.text: PapaPolar: it was our half of a code phrase. how we started each phone call so we knew we were on a secure line and everything was safe

g.title: j1593371657
g.text: PapaPolar: we had a code phrase. it was how we started each phone call so we knew we were on a secure line and everything was safe

g.title: j1054698419
g.text: MomToxicated: That we were actually... ourselves.

g.title: j17816325
g.text: PapaPolar: "On empty crossroads, seek the eclipse" was our half.

g.title: j1488732311
g.text: MomToxicated: "For when Sol and Lua align, the lost shall find their way home" was the responding half.

g.title: j3730973429
g.text: MomToxicated: *Her* half.

g.title: j701371379
g.text: But we can't be sure it was her, like you said, Minerva. The Indifference knows what she knows.

g.title: j1454679532
g.text: I don't know why the Indifference would tell you that...

g.title: j3963569415
g.text: MomToxicated: But why would it be trying to give us a sense of hope? Unless it was simply trying to hurt us.

g.title: j1644522989
g.text: MomToxicated: Through false hope, perhaps? To cause us pain?

g.title: j2669670842
g.text: PapaPolar: is this painful?

g.title: j1455633978
g.text: PapaPolar: is it false, though? is this painful?

g.title: j3503167413
g.text: PapaPolar: or is it some kind of peace, to know our little girl is still alive out there, somewhere?

g.title: j3518332689
g.text: PapaPolar: that despite all odds, she's still kicking ass and taking names?

g.title: j951919769
g.text: PapaPolar: even if it isn't with us?

g.title: j3883969478
g.text: PapaPolar: that warms my big dumb heart, i don't know about you.

g.title: j178838453
g.text: PapaPolar: 'n something tells me that's not what the so-called indifference is in the business of doing

g.title: j1887005619
g.text: MomToxicated: You're very right. Hearing that phrase, thinking she even *might* still be out there, isn't painful.

g.title: j4088537255
g.text: MomToxicated: I'm proud of her.

g.title: j979748482
g.text: Even if she's still being held hostage by the Indifference?

g.title: j691732820
g.text: Even if it's a trick by the Indifference?

g.title: j1847334428
g.text: She could be willingly working with the Indifference.

g.title: j4273980713
g.text: PapaPolar: she's as tough as a bag of framing nails in a big 'ol block of cast titanium

g.title: j1645805809
g.text: MomToxicated: Why? What for? What does he have to gain from the two of us?

g.title: j3270032581
g.text: MomToxicated: Then she has one of the most powerful allies in the universe. In existence. She picked a side. So did we.

g.title: j1037068291
g.text: PapaPolar: and i'm betting yer "man in the wall" knew that, and that's why he took her in the first place

g.title: j1031151975
g.text: PapaPolar: we're small fry to that thing. which i say in the best way possible

g.title: j1214945351
g.text: MomToxicated: Hopefully, we'll never have to point guns at each other. And if we do? Then we'll deal with it.

g.title: j2644966993
g.text: PapaPolar: nah. she'll be fine. either she's already long gone, or they've got a mutual arrangement, or she's holding his ass hostage. lol

g.title: j2443273231
g.text: MomToxicated: No, I think the message was real. And I think it was from our little girl. Telling us... she's still out there.

g.title: j231693107
g.text: PapaPolar: she's can take care of herself, though. that's how we raised her

g.title: j3062267991
g.text: MomToxicated: Telling us, in her own way, that she's "okay."

g.title: j2069894144
g.text: MomToxicated: And that we can stop worrying about her.

g.title: j3078291469
g.text: PapaPolar: heh. like we ever could

g.title: j2224347043
g.text: MomToxicated: The curse and blessing of being a parent.

g.title: j1874537113
g.text: PapaPolar: you ever want kids, drifter? eeeh, don't answer that. probably some void nonsense i don't wanna know about.

g.title: j3803697792
g.text: Drinks? Drinks.

g.title: j967664429
g.text: Good call.

g.title: j988960737
g.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>

g.title: j2636017994
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1971653661
g.text: PapaPolar: well, it's not a happy-happy smile. it's a melancholy-happy smile? but

g.title: j500106890
g.text: MomToxicated: That is a valid response, I agree. Heh. What do you both say to a few drinks?

g.title: j3225910860
g.text: MomToxicated: Now you're really speaking our language.

g.title: j1103813791
g.text: PapaPolar: i'd like to go put back a few and tell some good stories about our lil girl

g.title: j3070956713
g.text: PapaPolar: now yer talkin'

g.title: j1588088953
g.text: MomToxicated: And... Drifter? Thank you. Again. For all that you do.

g.title: j3370756614
g.text: PapaPolar: yeah. seriously, lil buddy. i don't know how we'll ever be able to repay you. but if the chance comes? we'll be there.

g.title: j3501331032
g.text: PapaPolar: you're family now, whether you like it or not. 8-)
